guidance: docs/SUPERVISOR_FEEDBACK_2026-11-11.md (AI takes over the modeling, validation TEA held out, disagreement rule fixed in advance); user 2026-11-13: build mode V3 after the five-layer design (Notion 40), model gpt-5.6-sol via API-YES credential GPT-personal, and ammonia decomposition as the new reaction that covers the three optima (atomic, laboratory, industrial) of the NCE paper.
build_mode: V3.1-five-layer (docs/V3_FIVE_LAYER_DESIGN.md; V3.1 = user 2026-11-13: zero energy/heat duty of a regenerator, furnace or separation unit needs measured/published evidence; one fixed price table prices.json that the agent cites and may not change; deterministic run_sensitivity (no LLM); critic on a different model, gpt-5.6-luna): design basis with evidence (basis.json), PARAMS contract, decisions log, physics gate with V2 lower bounds plus upper bounds and capital plausibility, evidence debt from assumption sensitivity (10 % of cost or energy) that must be resolved before finish, one independent critic (fresh context, artefacts only, at most 2 rounds); --atomic: literature-built atomic.py on the generic mkm_solver.py, check_atomic, run_three_optima. V3 was designed after the CO2-methanation holdout results were seen, so methanation is not evidence for V3; ammonia decomposition is its first test.
task: runner.py <run> 'ammonia decomposition to hydrogen (2 NH3 -> N2 + 3 H2)' --build nh3dec --atomic

agent.route: API-YES credential GPT-personal (fallback: credential 邪修gpt, then other routes)
agent.critic_model: gpt-5.6-luna (separate call, fresh context, artefacts only)
agent.workspace: D:/agent_runs/<run> (outside the repository); scripts restricted to relative paths

not_visible_to_the_agent: agent/new_reactions/plant_models.py, plant_framework.py, configs/* (incl. nh3dec_ours.json), params*.json, SOURCES.md, results/*
the NCE ammonia harness (provenance/*/source_harness, analysis/*): its scaling fits, descriptor values and optimum
the NCE repository and its PRs (url fragments audited)
builds: 3 independent builds nh3dec_b1..b3 (separate workspaces); a build that fails check_model or check_atomic at finish, or whose holdout audit finds a leak, is invalid and replaced; every replacement is reported

validation.plant: evaluate_builds.py against holdout/nh3dec.json: NH3 incl. fuel 7.28 t/t H2 +-12 %, fired duty + primary electricity 45.6 GJ/t +-35 %, capital per annual t H2 on the Ishimoto scale curve -30/+50 %; pass = 3/3, partial = 2/3 and none beyond twice the tolerance, fail otherwise
validation.atomic: optimum N binding weaker than the build's own Ru value by 0.33 +- 0.20 eV at 850 K, 0.99/0.0075/0.0025 bar NH3/H2/N2 (Hansgen 2010); within / outside, reported separately
validation.hidden_reference_report_only: hand-built plant model configs/nh3dec_ours.json (Spearman on common records); NCE harness reverse-direction volcano (argmax and Spearman; method still being checked, not gated)

agreement_rule.per_conclusion: largest cost item, controlling catalyst property, cheapest catalyst on the common record set (records present in all three builds), atomic optimum descriptor relative to Ru (agree if within 0.2 eV), laboratory optimum, industrial optimum: robust = 3/3, majority = 2/3, model-dependent = no majority; all three builds reported
agreement_rule.quantitative: reference-cost spread max/min - 1 <= 20 % and every pairwise Spearman of record costs >= 0.8 is called consistent
agreement_rule.primary_build: the build with the median reference cost, fixed before the holdout comparison is looked at
agreement_rule.selection: no selection of builds by TEA fit

ledger: stage_ledger.csv per build (incl. critic tokens); human_log.csv (every human intervention with type and minutes)
